title: Startup Log Triage
description: An API startup failed. The startup log contains the cause, and the conflicting CLI Quest process is still running.
mission: Identify the root cause in logs/startup.log, write it into answer.txt, and free TCP port 18083.
success: You connected the log evidence to the running process and freed the port.

lesson.what_happened: The log identified a bind failure, then process inspection found the port owner.
lesson.be_careful: Confirm process ownership before sending a signal.

files.content:
INFO loading configuration
INFO connecting database
ERROR listen tcp :18083: bind: address already in use
FATAL API startup aborted

hints: Search the startup log for ERROR or FATAL.
The error names the port that failed to bind.
Find the listener on 18083, verify it is the CLI Quest helper, and stop it.

ja.title: 起動logの切り分け
ja.description: API起動失敗の原因がlogにあり、競合processが動いています。
ja.mission: logs/startup.logから原因をanswer.txtへ書き、TCP port 18083を解放してください。
ja.success: logとprocessを結びつけてportを解放しました。

lesson.what_happened: logからbind failureを特定し、process調査でport ownerを見つけました。
lesson.be_careful: signal送信前にprocess ownerを確認しましょう。
